nodes.label: Mazesta Test diagnostics suite
nodes.rationale: Persian-first .NET 10 suite for a PC service shop; interface is a local web page in one WebView2, WPF retired.

nodes.label: Honesty rules (no fake or guessed data)
nodes.rationale: The product's core value: unavailable values are null, a test that did not run is never a pass, a pass needs measured evidence.

nodes.label: Downward-only project layers
nodes.rationale: Logic goes in the lowest layer that can hold it so it is unit-testable without a window.

nodes.label: Real-machine verification rule
nodes.rationale: Unit tests never count as verification of hardware or UI behaviour; the published app must be run on the owner's machine.

nodes.label: Two editions: Mazesta's and the users'
nodes.rationale: One code base; company-only features are gated on WebBridge.Staff and boot.staff.

nodes.label: Release notes never name the sensor and lighting stack
nodes.rationale: Customers read that the sensors and lighting were upgraded; component names stay in code and third-party notices.
